name: SEMPAC
old_description: DEVELOPMENT & MANUFACTURING OF OPEN CAVITY PACKAGES FOR SEMICONDUCTORS
about:
SEMPAC is a privately-owned semiconductor packaging company based in Beaverton, Oregon, in the region known as the Silicon Forest. Founded in 2000 by veterans of the integrated circuit assembly industry, the company was created to offer a more reliable and less expensive alternative to the JEDEC-compliant packages then used for device prototyping and testing. The founders leveraged 50 years of combined experience to develop packaging solutions that did not require specialized assembly equipment or complicated storage.

The company designs, develops, and manufactures pre-molded open cavity plastic packages under the Open-Pak™ brand. Its product line spans QFN, QFP, SOIC, and SSOP architectures in body sizes from 3×3 mm to 12×12 mm, lead counts from 8 to 100, and lead pitches of 0.4 mm to 1.0 mm. Packages are molded with green (halogen-free) compounds, plated with gold over nickel for bondability, and conform to JEDEC outlines. SEMPAC also produces B-Stage lids and offers custom package design. All materials are RoHS 3 and REACH compliant.

SEMPAC serves the semiconductor assembly sector, supplying packages for high-frequency RF, optoelectronics, and power devices in both military and commercial applications. Its customers include integrated circuit manufacturers and assembly houses that need prototyping and test packages without the constraints of traditional contract manufacturing. The company emphasizes collaborative partnerships and does not compete with its customers.

SEMPAC differentiates itself through independence—remaining free of conflicts of interest—and a quality culture that includes inspection at every production stage, from raw material validation to final shipment. The company also commits to environmental responsibility, ensuring products are free of heavy metals per RoHS 3 (EU Directive 2015/863), and to ethical labor practices throughout its supply chain.

about:
SF Cable, Inc. operates from Hayward, California, where it has built over two decades of experience in the cable and connectivity supply business. The company does not disclose a precise founding year or founder names, nor does it state its ownership structure.

The firm functions as a wholesale distributor, stocking a broad range of power cables, data cables, adapters, and connectivity accessories. Its catalog includes HDMI cables, Cat5e and Cat6 patch cords, universal power cords (NEMA 5-15 to C13), extension cords, DB9 serial cables, USB 2.0/3.0/Type-C cables, DisplayPort cables, fiber optic trunk cables, and modular adapters.

SF Cable serves buyers across sectors that require reliable cable and interconnect solutions — IT and network infrastructure, audio/video installation, industrial equipment, and consumer electronics — though the only industry designation explicitly stated on its site is "Industry Expertise." Customers range from resellers and system integrators to end-user organizations needing quick-turn cable supplies.

The company positions its offering around five stated commitments: a lifetime warranty on all cables and non-electronics products, no minimum orders or restocking fees, 60-day money-back guarantee, free lifetime technical support, and same-day shipping on in-stock items.

name: SK Food Group Inc
old_description: Your Imagination, Our Acceleration: Lightning-Fast Custom Food Development & Assembly
about:
SK Food Group traces its roots to 1942 when it began as a mobile catering operation in Seattle, Washington. The company, now headquartered in Reno, Nevada, has grown through a series of ownership changes and name transitions—including Don Campbell's Quality Food Service in 1979 and Stover's Kitchen in 2004—before selling its catering division in 2006 to focus exclusively on food manufacturing.

Today the company operates nine state-of-the-art facilities across the United States and Canada, employing more than 2,000 associates. Its plants are custom-built for Ready-to-Eat production, featuring motorized conveyor systems, precision slicing lines for meat and cheese, and extensive cold-storage, dry-storage, and dock infrastructure. All locations are USDA or CFIA certified and carry SQF Version 9.1 certification; the Burnsville and Lakeville, Minnesota sites also hold USDA Organic and Gluten-Free certifications.

SK Food Group serves a broad spectrum of foodservice customers, from independent cafes to Fortune 500 brands, supplying handcrafted sandwiches, wraps, flatbreads, burgers, protein snacks, and charcuterie boards. The company also offers private-label development and assembly, working under strict confidentiality agreements to protect client recipes and packaging intellectual property.

The firm emphasizes a hands-on, confidential partnership model, positioning itself as a collaborator that moves from concept to production while maintaining rigorous food-safety standards. Its "Your Imagination, Our Acceleration" tagline reflects a focus on rapid custom development backed by high-capacity automation.

about:
Established in Sandy Hook, Connecticut, SMT Corp. has supported organizations reliant on reliable electronic components for over 25 years, with a track record serving aerospace and defense primes since 1995. The company operates a U.S. headquarters in Sandy Hook and a wholly owned subsidiary, SMT Labs UK, in Rochester, Kent, extending its accredited testing capabilities into Europe.

SMT Corp. provides electronic component sourcing, authentication, testing, qualification, and inventory management services. Its capabilities include hard-to-find and obsolete component sourcing, independent open-market procurement, advanced laboratory testing to MIL-STD-750 and MIL-STD-883, counterfeit detection per AS6171 High-Risk Level 2, and excess and end-of-life asset evaluation and resale. The company holds AS6171 HRL2 accreditation—one of only two facilities worldwide with that designation—and DLA Qualified Testing Suppliers List status for testing untraceable products.

The company serves defense, aerospace, space, critical infrastructure, medical, telecommunications, data infrastructure, and high-performance computing markets. Customers include defense and aerospace prime contractors, government agencies, and organizations managing difficult-to-source, obsolete, or high-risk electronic components across North America, Europe, and global markets.

name: SMW Designs
old_description: SMW Designs has been providing quality custom woodworking services in Billings and surrounding areas since 2018. We are a full-service woodshop ready to turn your dream into a reality.
about:
SMW Designs operates from Billings, Montana, where it was founded in 2018 by Keith Wetmore, known to friends as Sonny, and his wife Melissa. The business began after Wetmore, a former delivery driver, discovered a passion for finish work while building his own kitchen cabinets. His first major commission came shortly after: 14 restaurant tables that launched the shop into full-time production.

The woodshop provides a full range of custom woodworking services, including kitchen cabinets, butcher block countertops, tables, desks, mantles, wet bars, fireplace surrounds, built-in organizers, bathroom vanities, and exterior projects such as shed repairs, decks, and patios. It also produces smaller retail items like cutting boards and cribbage boards through an online store. Every project is custom designed, built, delivered, and installed by the shop.

The company serves residential homeowners throughout Billings and surrounding areas, as well as commercial clients such as restaurants needing custom tables. Past projects include a walnut freestanding shelf for a private residence, butcher block countertops shipped to Idaho, and custom plaques for belt-buckle displays. The shop also supports local institutions, having performed repairs at Burlington Ball Park.

Wetmore emphasizes a hands-on, collaborative approach, offering free estimates and working directly with clients to design unique hardwood solutions. The business highlights its personal customer service, inclusive project management from design through installation, and community involvement as key differentiators.

about:
SOLERS-PI Inc. is headquartered in New Berlin, Wisconsin. The company operates as the U.S. subsidiary of SOLERS, which was renamed from Progressive Image Inc. on August 1, 2021. SOLERS specializes in the development and engineering of cable assemblies and harnesses, serving as an independent manufacturer or in direct partnership with customers.

The company designs and produces customized cable assemblies and harnesses for manufacturers of state-of-the-art electronic and electrical equipment. Its processes include CAD systems that minimize development time and support remote drawing and data exchange during approval, along with state-of-the-art production methodologies. In 2024, SOLERS expanded its New Berlin workshop by approximately 850 square meters to accommodate additional capital equipment and engineering staff. Previous expansions include a capability upgrade at its Bar-Lev Industrial Zone facility in Israel (2023) and a 1,450-square-meter workshop addition at its Zhongshan, China site (2022).

SOLERS serves manufacturers of advanced electronic and electrical equipment that require highly customized cable assemblies and harnesses. The company works directly with these manufacturers as an independent supplier or as an engineering partner.

SOLERS emphasizes implemented work processes and procedures to meet the highest quality standards expected by customers and certification bodies. Its stated goals are to reduce assembly time, minimize failure rates, and safeguard electrical and mechanical performance, delivering customized solutions quickly and cost-effectively.

about:
SPAL USA, the North American subsidiary of Italy's SPAL Automotive Srl, has operated from Ankeny, Iowa since 1989. The company runs a 40,000-square-foot sales and distribution center that supplies cooling components and customized systems to OEM and aftermarket customers across the continent.

The facility stocks and supports a full line of thermal-management products manufactured by its parent company: brushed and brushless axial fans, brushed and brushless centrifugal blowers, and brushless coolant pumps. These components feature IP68 and IP6K9K sealed motors, integrated EMC filtering, and smart controls such as PWM, CAN, and LIN interfaces. SPAL USA adds value by configuring these building blocks into application-specific cooling packages for vehicles and stationary equipment.

The customer base spans on- and off-highway markets. In the automotive sector, SPAL USA serves car, bus and coach, powersport, and truck OEMs. It also supplies agriculture and construction machinery builders, mobile refrigeration units, oil-cooling systems, and a range of stationary industrial applications. Both original equipment manufacturers and aftermarket distributors rely on the Ankeny center for technical support and rapid fulfillment.

SPAL Automotive Srl brings more than 60 years of design and production experience to the partnership. The group's stated mission is to deliver the highest-quality cooling products through continuous R&D investment and tight control over every manufacturing step. That heritage, combined with local inventory and engineering support, is what SPAL USA presents as its differentiator in the North American market.

name: SSE Steel Fabrication (formerly Southern Services & Equipment, Inc.)
old_description: SSE Steel Fabrication specializes in architectural and structural fabrication, utilizing state-of-the-art technology and the latest in robotic machinery, delivering hundreds of precision-engineered steel solutions for high-profile commercial, industrial, and municipal projects across the United States.
about:
Established in St. Bernard, Louisiana, SSE Steel Fabrication (formerly Southern Services & Equipment, Inc.) operates as a 100% woman- and minority-owned small business led by President and CEO Mindy Nunez Airhart. The company serves commercial clients and government agencies from a 22,000-square-foot fabrication facility complemented by a 2-acre blast and paint yard and a 10-acre laydown yard.

SSE specializes in architectural and structural steel fabrication, employing robotic welding, CNC machining, and a suite of automated equipment that includes the PythonX Structural Fabrication System, welding cobots, a robotic structural beam line, and an HD oxygen/plasma burn table. The shop also provides structural steel erection, product assembly, on-site welding and repair, in-house design and drafting, prototyping, sandblasting, painting, and quality measurement control.

The firm’s customer base spans commercial, government, defense, aerospace, industrial, retail, and municipal sectors. Concrete project examples include the structural steel scope for the New Orleans Police Department 2nd District Station and fabricated and erected components for the Louis Armstrong International Airport North Terminal. SSE also holds certifications with the Louisiana Department of Transportation and Development, Alabama Department of Transportation, and other public agencies.

SSE differentiates itself through early adoption of automation — notably the first robotic CNC plasma machine in south Louisiana — and by maintaining AISC certification with a Bridge Component Manufacturing endorsement. The company emphasizes precision, code compliance, and turnkey project support from detailing through delivery.
